bugs.name: Wiki search submission gives no result or navigation
bugs.summary: Searching a wiki for a saved page title or content leaves the query in the field without results or a message.
bugs.expected: Wiki search should show matches or a no-results state after submission.
bugs.actual: Pressing Enter with a matching page title or content leaves the page URL and content unchanged and shows no search results.
reproSteps: Create a disposable wiki page with a unique title and content in a repository.
Enter the title or content in Search wiki on the saved page.
Press Enter and inspect the URL and page for results or feedback.

bugs.name: Mobile wiki revision history omits the diff link
bugs.summary: At 390×844, the wiki revision history shows no SHA1 link; selecting the older revision leaves the user on the history page, while the desktop SHA1 link opens its diff.
bugs.expected: From Page revisions at a 390 CSS-pixel viewport, the user can open the selected revision's diff. The same history view provides SHA1 links to commit diffs at desktop width.
bugs.actual: At 390×844, the history table displayed Author, Message, and Date, with no SHA1 column. Clicking the older revision's message and row left the user on Page revisions, including after waiting. Horizontal scrolling revealed no additional column; the row's copy control only displayed “Copied!” and did not open a diff. At 1280×900, clicking the older revision's SHA1 opened its commit diff.
reproSteps: Open a fresh browser, load the supplied authorized admin session as momentic-admin, and navigate to /momentic-admin/field-notes/wiki.
Through the UI, create a new private repository named momentic-wiki-diff-mobile-9f31c2, keeping “Make repository private” selected.
Open the repository Wiki and create the page mobile-diff-check with distinct initial content and the commit message “Create initial wiki revision.”
Edit the page, save different content, and use the commit message “Expand wiki page for revision two.”
At a 390×844 viewport, open the page revisions at /momentic-admin/momentic-wiki-diff-mobile-9f31c2/wiki/mobile-diff-check.-?action=_revision.
Click the older revision's “Create initial wiki revision” message and its row. The view remains on Page revisions without showing a diff.
